description: Implementation of MojoDemuxerStreamAdapter class for media stream handling in Chromium, including stream initialization, reading buffers, and configuration updates.

classes.name: MojoDemuxerStreamAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for handling demuxer stream via Mojo interface, managing buffer reading, configuration, and stream state.

methods.name: MojoDemuxerStreamAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with a Mojo demuxer stream and a callback for stream readiness.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Initiates reading a specified number of buffers from the stream.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the stream (audio or video).

methods.name: EnableBitstreamConverter
methods.description: Enables bitstream conversion on the demuxer stream.

methods.name: OnStreamReady
methods.description: Callback when the stream is ready, sets stream type and configurations.

methods.name: OnBufferReady
methods.description: Handles buffer batch readiness, manages config changes and buffer queue.

methods.name: OnBufferRead
methods.description: Processes individual decoder buffers read from the stream.

methods.name: UpdateConfig
methods.description: Updates decoder configuration based on stream type.
